partners.diseaseBName: combined osteogenesis imperfecta and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome 1
partners.mechanism_chain: COL1A1 (HGNC:2197) —DISRUPTS→ Type I collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0005577); Type I collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0005577) —LEADS_TO→ Bone fragility (HP:0002759); Type I collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0005577) —LEADS_TO→ Skin hyperextensibility (HP:0001065); Type I collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0005577) —LEADS_TO→ Joint hypermobility (HP:0001382). Mutations in COL1A1 disrupt the normal synthesis and assembly of type I collagen, leading to impaired collagen structure and function. This disruption affects bone integrity, causing bone fragility (osteogenesis imperfecta type 1), and also impacts connective tissues, leading to skin hyperextensibility and joint hypermobility (combined osteogenesis imperfecta and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome 1).
